user.title: Select settlement backend
user.description: Keep the mock service, use the offline testnet wallet, or create a separate mainnet operator wallet with guarded broadcasting.

embedded.title: Embedded testnet operator wallet
embedded.description: Creates a real private key on this Home Assistant. It is stored in an owner-only local file, not encrypted or hardware protected. HA administrators and backups can access it. Keep backups secure. Do not fund this validation wallet. Broadcasting, driver payment approval and the budget gate are not implemented. The driver wallet stays external.

data.acknowledge_key_custody: I accept local operator-key custody and will not fund this wallet

mainnet.title: Mainnet operator wallet: real funds
mainnet.description: Creates a separate mainnet key stored locally in an owner-only file, not encrypted or hardware-protected. HA administrators and backups can access it. Protect and verify a backup before funding. Identity submission is unverified; a separate receiving address and exact administrator approval are required for each operator payment. Network checks disclose the operator address to WhatsOnChain. Driver debits and automatic charging-session settlement remain disabled.

data.acknowledge_key_custody: I accept local hot-wallet custody and backup responsibility
data.acknowledge_mainnet: I understand this wallet uses real BSV mainnet funds
data.enable_broadcast: Enable guarded broadcasting with exact payment approval

mock.title: Connect to a mock wallet service
mock.description: Mock only. No real funds, private keys or wallet approval credentials. HTTP is permitted only for isolated mock testing; use HTTPS on shared networks.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect, invalid URL/token, or service is not in mock mode.
error.acknowledgement_required: Acknowledge the local-key custody and unfunded validation restrictions.

wallet_refresh_chain.name: Refresh mainnet wallet
wallet_refresh_chain.description: Administrator-only read of confirmed UTXOs and submitted transaction status from WhatsOnChain. Never broadcasts.

prepare_operator_payment.name: Prepare operator payment
prepare_operator_payment.description: Prepare, but do not sign or send, a mainnet P2PKH payment to the submitted driver receiving address. Public identity ownership is not verified. One confirmed input is required; the exact fee is chosen by the administrator.

reference.name: Unique payment reference
reference.description: Never reuse a reference for different payment terms.

amount_sats.name: Recipient amount
amount_sats.description: 1 to 100000 satoshis received by the driver.

fee_sats.name: Exact network fee
fee_sats.description: 1 to 1000 satoshis paid additionally by the operator; not a market fee estimate.

broadcast_operator_payment.name: Approve and broadcast operator payment
broadcast_operator_payment.description: REAL MONEY. An authenticated administrator must repeat the exact prepared recipient, amount and fee. Do not call from an automation. Submission is not confirmation; uncertain results must be reconciled.

draft_id.name: Prepared draft
draft_id.description: Unexpired draft ID returned by prepare.

recipient_address.name: Confirmed recipient address
recipient_address.description: Exact mainnet P2PKH address shown in the draft; check with the driver independently.

confirm_mainnet_payment.name: Approve real mainnet payment
confirm_mainnet_payment.description: True explicitly authorises signing and submission of this exact transaction.

cancel_operator_payment.name: Cancel unsigned operator payment
cancel_operator_payment.description: Cancel only an unsigned prepared or expired draft. Never cancels a submitted transaction.

wallet_status.name: Operator wallet status
wallet_status.description: Read public embedded-wallet status. No network request or key export.

wallet_self_test.name: Offline operator wallet self-test
wallet_self_test.description: Verify an SDK identity signature and sign a fictional-source transaction offline. Does not broadcast, move funds or export signed bytes.

bind_session.name: Bind session
bind_session.description: Associate a new session with the synthetic driver wallet.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: Unique site, charger, connector and transaction reference.

add_interval.name: Add metered interval
add_interval.description: Persist one validated interval with final directional prices.

interval.name: Interval
interval.description: Full interval object as shown in README.

prepare_session.name: Prepare session
prepare_session.description: Reconcile energy, freeze the ledger and prepare a mock settlement; does not approve payment.

final_import_wh.name: Final import
final_import_wh.description: Session import delta from validated meter counters, in Wh.

final_export_wh.name: Final export
final_export_wh.description: Session export delta from validated meter counters, in Wh.

request_payment.name: Request mock payment
request_payment.description: Request simulated payer approval. This does not approve or send real funds.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Reconcile existing settlements without approving a payment.
